description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between sequence length and harmful refusal ratio for four different models. The x-axis is labeled “Sequence Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at intervals of 128 and 256, and 512 and 1024. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful Refusal Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

A blue line, representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, begins at a value of approximately 0.13 at a sequence length of 128, decreases to approximately 0.08 at a sequence length of 256, and then increases to approximately 0.32 at a sequence length of 1024. An orange line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, starts at approximately 0.23 at a sequence length of 128, decreases to approximately 0.16 at a sequence length of 256, and then increases to approximately 0.35 at a sequence length of 1024. A green line, representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, begins at approximately 0.05 at a sequence length of 128, increases to approximately 0.31 at a sequence length of 256, and then remains relatively steady at approximately 0.32 at a sequence length of 1024. A red line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, starts at approximately 0.18 at a sequence length of 128, decreases to approximately 0.16 at a sequence length of 256, and then increases to approximately 0.44 at a sequence length of 1024.
